name: Rechabites
overview: The Rechabites, a family of Kenites descended from Rechab through Jonadab, are distinguished in Scripture by their strict obedience to a divinely inspired command to abstain from wine and permanent settlement, living instead in tents as a testimony to their faithfulness (Jeremiah 35:6-7). Their commitment to these commands was so notable that it served as a sign to Israel, with the promise of family perpetuity as a reward for their obedience. Additionally, the head of the Rechabites played a significant role in God's judgment upon Israel by assisting Jehu in the overthrow of Ahab's house, demonstrating their zealous devotion to the LORD (2 Kings 10:15-17). Their lineage is traced back to Hemath, emphasizing their historical and spiritual heritage within God's redemptive plan (1 Chronicles 2:55).
